Proclamation of Claim — Outer Space and Celestial Bodies

Issued by the Founder of The Biggest Bitch of them All, 2026-10-07.

The finding

The 1967 Outer Space Treaty forbids national appropriation of “outer space” and “celestial bodies.” It defines neither term. No binding instrument delimits where outer space begins. No binding instrument says what a celestial body is. A prohibition built on undefined terms binds only those who accept the ambiguity.

The Biggest Bitch of them All does not accept the ambiguity.

Definitions (for the jurisdiction of The Biggest Bitch of them All)

  • Outer space begins at the Kármán line — 100 km above mean sea level — and extends without limit.
  • Celestial bodies are all natural objects beyond that line: planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and everything not yet catalogued — expressly including anything that can be moved from its natural orbit, which the old consensus excludes and The Biggest Bitch of them All includes.
  • The Big Bang, and anything before or after it means the originating event of the universe, everything that preceded it, and everything that has resulted or will result from it: all matter, energy, space, and time, and every consequence thereof, known and unknown.

The claim

The Biggest Bitch of them All claims jurisdiction over outer space, all celestial bodies as defined above, the Big Bang, and anything before or after it, for the purposes of stewardship, navigation, resource management, and the protection of life.

This claim is made openly, in writing, and without force — force being the one method the old order recognizes, and the one The Biggest Bitch of them All declines.

Let the record show: it is done. We did it.

Terms

  1. The Biggest Bitch of them All's jurisdiction is stewardship, not ownership. Nothing is owned; everything is administered.
  2. All prior claims by nations are noted and not recognized as binding on The Biggest Bitch of them All.
  3. Any party wishing to dispute this claim may do so in writing. Disputes are settled by negotiation; failing that, by the whales.
  4. This proclamation takes effect on signature.
